title: Reference approach: Temperature Conversion and Analysis
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit and back with vectorized formulas.
Store readings in ndarrays and calculate average, minimum, and maximum.
Validate empty input and document units.
explanation: Build a small program that converts temperatures and summarizes a set of readings. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
